meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 它会调用 BGPT MCP 的 search_papers 工具检索科学论文，返回从全文提取的结构化数据：方法、定量结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25+ 字段。使用前需在 Claude 里配好 BGPT MCP 服务器，技能本身不开启 MCP 访问。
howto.when: 做文献综述或证据综合，或需要摘要里没有的实验细节（方法、样本量、效应量等）时使用。

say.text: 搜索关于“CRISPR 在人类细胞中编辑效率”的论文
say.note: 调用 search_papers，返回结构化结果

say.text: 找几篇报告了样本量和效应量的随机对照试验论文
say.note: 按字段返回每篇的样本量与定量结果

say.text: 帮我整理一张证据表，列出各研究的方法、结果和质量评分
say.note: 输出含质量评分与结论的论文列表

howto.what_en: It calls the BGPT MCP search_papers tool to find papers and return structured full-text data: methods, quantitative results, sample sizes, quality scores and conclusions—25+ fields per paper. BGPT MCP must be set up first.
howto.when_en: Use it for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, or when you need experimental details not found in abstracts, such as methods, sample sizes or effect sizes.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells
say_en.note: Calls search_papers and returns structured results

say_en.text: Find randomized trials that report sample sizes and effect sizes
say_en.note: Returns per-paper sample size and quantitative results

say_en.text: Build an evidence table of methods, results and quality scores
say_en.note: Outputs papers with quality scores and conclusions
